g.text: Matched sensory scenes; cue identity changes the requested report
Only cue overlays change, with raw pre-overlay scenes and all rotations held fixed. New labels are recomputed. Left conditions the newly cued target
to be unchanged; the same old-target physical evidence is now irrelevant. Right uses all matched pairs at each magnitude; 95% paired trial
bootstrap. This is target reassignment, NOT an invalid-cue benefit or a cue-validity experiment.
